  let hilightData = dataEle.children(".hilightData").first().html();
  if (hilightData!="") {hilightData = hilightData.split(";;").map((e) => e.trim());}
  let banData = dataEle.children(".banData").first().html();
  if (banData!="") {banData = banData.split(";;").map((e) => e.trim());}
  
  function createSvg(tagName) {
    return document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", tagName);
  }

        "viewBox": "0 0 253 253",

    })
  dataEle.after(svg)
  
  let bg = $(createSvg("rect"))
    .attr({
        "fill": "#000",
        "width": "253",
        "height": "253"
    })
  svg.append(bg)
  
  let star = $(createSvg("path"))
    .attr({
        "fill": "#f7ac52",
        "d": "m 124.36172,110 c 0,0 0.395,9.68753 -1.90946,12.09414 C 120.14779,124.50076 110,124.36172 110,124.36172 v 4.27656 c 0,0 9.68752,-0.395 12.09415,1.90946 2.40662,2.30447 2.26757,12.45226 2.26757,12.45226 h 4.27656 c 0,0 -0.395,-9.68752 1.90946,-12.09415 C 132.85221,128.49924 143,128.63828 143,128.63828 v -4.27656 c 0,0 -9.68753,0.395 -12.09415,-1.90947 C 128.49923,120.1478 128.63828,110 128.63828,110 Z"
    })
  svg.append(star)
  
  let rectColor = {
    "1": "#6a6a6a",
    "2": "#f7ac52"
  }
  
  let appendRect = function(typeId, x, y) {
    let use = $(createSvg("rect"))
      .attr({
        "fill": rectColor[typeId],
        "x": x,
        "y": y,
        "width": "35",
        "height": "35"
      })
    svg.append(use)
  }
  
  //bound
  //lt
  for (let i=1; i<=3; i++) {
    let maxgird = 3 - i + 1
    for (let n=1; n<=maxgird; n++) {
        appendRect("1", 1 + 36*(n-1), 1 + 36*(i-1))
    }
  }
  //rt
  for (let i=1; i<=3; i++) {
    let maxgird = 3 - i + 1
    for (let n=1; n<=maxgird; n++) {
        appendRect("1", 217 - 36*(n-1), 1 + 36*(i-1))
    }
  }
  //lb
  for (let i=1; i<=3; i++) {
    let maxgird = 3 - i + 1
    for (let n=1; n<=maxgird; n++) {
        appendRect("1", 1 + 36*(n-1), 217 - 36*(i-1))
    }
  }
  //rb
  for (let i=1; i<=3; i++) {
    let maxgird = 3 - i + 1
    for (let n=1; n<=maxgird; n++) {
        appendRect("1", 217 - 36*(n-1), 217 - 36*(i-1))
    }
  }
  
  let cx = 1+36*3
  let cy = 1+36*3
  if (hilightData=="") {
  }else{
    hilightData.forEach((e)=>{
      cood = e.split(",")
      appendRect("2", cx + 36*cood[1], cy - 36*cood[0])
    })
  }
  
  let appendBan = function(x, y, dx, dy) {
    let use = $(createSvg("rect"))
      .attr({
        "fill": "#000",
        "x": x,
        "y": y,
        "width": "35",
        "height": "35"
      })
    svg.append(use)
    use = $(createSvg("path"))
      .attr({
        "fill": "#c7c7c7",
        "d": "m 112.125,112.125 v 2.50977 23.73046 2.50977 h 2.50977 23.73046 2.50977 v -2.50977 -23.73046 -2.50977 h -2.50977 -23.73046 z m 5.25977,2.75 h 18.23046 L 126.5,123.99023 Z m -2.50977,2.50977 9.11523,9.11523 -9.11523,9.11523 z m 23.25,0 v 18.23046 L 129.00977,126.5 Z m -11.625,11.625 9.11523,9.11523 h -18.23046 z",
        "transform": "translate("+dx+","+dy+")"
    })
    svg.append(use)
  }
  
  if (banData=="") {
  }else{
    banData.forEach((e)=>{
      cood = e.split(",")
      appendBan(cx + 36*cood[1], cy - 36*cood[0], 36*cood[1], - 36*cood[0])
    })
  }
}])</script></includeonly>
